headline: Good News Arrives, Long-Term Capital "Opens the Floodgates"
summary: Insurance institutions permitted to invest in Stock Connect stocks may now also invest in Stock Connect ETFs under existing rules, according to a regulatory letter reported by China Securities Journal.
why: Stock Connect links mainland Chinese investors with Hong Kong-listed shares, and insurers are large long-term institutional investors. Their access to these funds can shape flows into Hong Kong-listed equities.
why_moved: The letter expands the pool of insurance capital allowed into Stock Connect ETFs, which the input describes as opening the floodgates for long-term capital.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: 利好来了，长线资金“开闸”
